stock.description: BaWang International (Group) Holding Limited, operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in the development, production, sale, and distribution of products based on traditional Chinese herbs. The company's reach extends across the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Thailand, and Malaysia. Its business is divided into segments focusing on Hair-Care, Skin-Care, and a broader category of Other Household and Personal Care Products. Under brand names such as Bawang, Royal Wind, Herborn, and Litao, the firm provides a diverse portfolio of goods including various shampoos, hair treatments, skincare essentials, household cleaners, shower gels, laundry detergents, and anti-bacterial hand sanitizers. These items are made available to consumers through a network of distributors, traditional retail outlets, and its online sales channels. Beyond its herbal specialties, BaWang is also involved in the manufacturing, promotion, and trading of a general range of household and personal grooming products. Established in 2007, the company maintains its primary offices in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, and functions as a subsidiary of Fortune Station Limited.
